parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json; const id=String(body.onboarding_id??body.payload?.tracking?.utm_content??''); const eventId=String(body.event_id??body.id??''); const startsAt=String(body.starts_at??body.payload?.event?.start_time??''); const url=String(body.meeting_url??body.payload?.event?.location?.join_url??''); if(!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(id)||!eventId||!startsAt) throw new Error('onboarding_id, event_id, and starts_at are required'); const payload={onboarding_id:id,event_id:eventId,starts_at:startsAt,meeting_url:url}; return [{json:{...payload,payload_base64:Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(payload)).toString('base64')}}];

parameters.query: WITH input AS (SELECT convert_from(decode($1,'base64'),'UTF8')::jsonb p) SELECT app.record_kickoff_booking((p->>'onboarding_id')::uuid,p->>'event_id',(p->>'starts_at')::timestamptz,p->>'meeting_url') AS result FROM input;
